description: PowerModelsProtection.jl, published by lanl-ansi, adds fault-study formulations for PowerModels and PowerModelsDistribution with explicit generator, load and fault assumptions. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README neglects loads and treats improved inverter and protection-coordination models as future work. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Catalogue records for comparison are model-powermodels-jl. Compatibility with these records has not been assumed.
